description: Header file defining an unsynchronized fixed-size memory block pool and object pool classes for memory management within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: unsync_fixed_size_memory_block_pool
classes.description: A non-thread-safe memory pool managing fixed-size memory blocks.

classes.name: unsync_fixed_size_object_pool
classes.description: A template class providing object allocation/deallocation using the fixed-size memory pool.

methods.name: memory_block_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each memory block in bytes.

methods.name: nof_memory_blocks
methods.description: Returns the total number of memory blocks in the pool.

methods.name: nof_blocks_available
methods.description: Returns the number of available blocks for allocation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the memory pool is empty.

methods.name: allocate_node
methods.description: Allocates a memory node of specified size from the pool.

methods.name: deallocate_node
methods.description: Returns a memory node back to the pool.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new object of type T using the memory pool.
